target.title: refactor(gateway): consolidate TypeScript WebSocket clients
target.body:
Closes #105963

## What Problem This Solves

The Node runtime and Control UI maintained separate implementations of the same Gateway WebSocket protocol lifecycle. That duplicated handshake, request/response/event dispatch, reconnect, timeout, and sequence-gap behavior, making fixes easy to apply to only one client.

## Why This Change Was Made

This introduces one browser-safe protocol lifecycle engine in `@openclaw/gateway-client`, with thin Node and browser adapters that retain their transport-specific policy. The Node adapter keeps `ws`, TLS/origin/proxy, device-auth, and watchdog behavior; the Control UI keeps native `WebSocket`, WebCrypto/storage auth, mixed-content enforcement, its existing 800ms/1.7x/15s reconnect policy, timing telemetry, and UI error surfaces.

The Control UI now imports the browser entrypoint instead of implementing a second protocol stack or deep-importing Gateway protocol source files. The branch is net -5 lines and adds no compatibility shim or user-visible behavior change.

## User Impact

No intended user-visible change. Control UI connect, disconnect banner, reconnect timing, authentication failures, and recovery behavior remain the same, while future Gateway client fixes have one canonical lifecycle implementation.

## Evidence

- Exact head `ea53c0f8065b61ec9a42f23726b3a76c021f86d5` on Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxd27p70q68489ejv245tp76`: 189 core Gateway client tests, 18 package client tests, and 52 Control UI Gateway/store tests passed; production build passed; full TypeScript project check, all oxlint shards, and import-cycle check passed. [Run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29228790789)
- Full Control UI suite: 3,742/3,742 tests passed on source-equivalent pre-rebase head; the rebase only removed an obsolete CI baseline edit. [Run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29227195439)
- Real runtime proof on Testbox `tbx_01kxd17ajr9q02hfv6qptqh9g9`: source Control UI connected to an actual loopback Gateway, showed `Gateway connection lost` / `Reconnecting…` after shutdown, then restored `Ready to chat` after restart; three WebSocket attempts observed.
- Source-blind behavior validation passed all five contract clauses, including visible offline/reconnected states, persistent shell, three real WebSocket attempts, and no credential values.
- Autoreview completed clean after lifecycle findings were fixed and regression-tested; final lint-only commit review reported no accepted/actionable findings.
- `pnpm check:changed` currently stops at the Plugin SDK hash gate. The same hash mismatch reproduces unchanged on base `404651d9e83bffc85b204f3fb976aa3730ad1ab9`; all PR-owned remaining stages were run explicitly and passed.
